2116869131358065063.en_summary: Doug Kass has written 267 columns (More Tales From Nvidia) on @TheStreetPro over two years. Expresses concerns shared with Roger McNamee: society ill-prepared for AI risks; creators evade accountability; AI falls short of expectations with few paying enterprise customers; LLM limitations and errors persist despite scaling; massive integration costs and debt-financed AI investment create timing risks and inflationary pressure worse than internet era; only few AI firms likely succeed risking hundreds of billions in writeoffs; $CRWV (short) and $ORCL (short) already distressed with extended balance sheets and offshore financing. Other risks include fraud, cybersecurity, deskilling and power concentration. Links McNamee article on AI financial bubble.
2116869131358065063.zh_summary: Doug Kass在過去兩年在@TheStreetPro撰寫267篇《More Tales From Nvidia》專欄。表達與Roger McNamee相同的擔憂：社會未為AI負面後果做好準備；創造者回避責任；AI現實未達預期且企業客戶付費不足；大型語言模型限制與機率誤差即使擴張仍存在；大規模整合成本及債務融資的AI投資造成時間風險與通臀壓力，情況比互聯網時代更糟；只有少數AI公司可能成功，風險是數百億美元撥銷；$CRWV（空頭）與$ORCL（空頭）已處困境，資產負債表延長並有離岸融資。其他風險包括欺詐、網絡安全、技能下降與權力集中。並連結McNamee關於AI金融泡沫的文章。
